selection_note: Observed Swedish stock operation, for simulating existing buildings against measured energy use. Housing values are measured stock surveys; office values are named operator examples. Each value replaces one Sveby normal-use input and passed the epsm_studies cohort validation on a calibration and a disjoint hold-out sample (validation/catalogue/calibration_plan.md). Sveby normal use remains the default selection and the basis for compliance-style calculations.

S.meaning: Measured total air change of self-draught buildings, envelope infiltration included. The natural exchange is this total minus the building's envelope infiltration in conditioned-volume ACH, and at least 0.05 ACH.

source_locators.heating_setpoint_c_by_era: BETSI (Boverket 2010) table 3.6, p. 66: measured mean apartment temperature by construction year (-60, 61-75, 76-85, 86-95, 96-05). SE.06 and SE.07 postdate the survey and take the newest measured class.
source_locators.ventilation.S.total_air_change_ach: BETSI (Boverket 2010) section 4.2.2: tracer-gas total air change in self-draught multi-family buildings.

source_locators.use.mechanical_vent_l_s_m2: Sveby Brukarindata kontor 1.0, chapter 5 background, p. 12: named examples, not a stock survey. Brostaden reports many offices around 1.6 L/(s m2) Atemp, JM's head office 1.2, and new consultancy offices 1.5.
source_locators.operation_inputs.ventilation: Sveby Brukarindata kontor 1.0, chapter 5 background, p. 12: many operators run one hour before opening and after closing; Skanska normally runs 06-20 on working days. A named example, not a stock survey.

not_adopted.single_family: BETSI table 3.3 setpoints by era (20.8-21.9 C) and the 0.40 ACH self-draught total did not pass the hold-out acceptance rule; single-family overprediction follows the model conditioning more floor than the EPC Atemp, a geometry question rather than an operating one.
not_adopted.school: No school operating input has a sourced measured-use range yet.
